subject: Distance sampling using point transects in half a circle

messages.author: 9a8329c791f1f374
messages.subject: Distance sampling using point transects in half a circle
parts:
Dear all,
My name is Antonella from Argentina. I am working with a set of data of bird species using point transects. I have experience in working with Density Surface Models and line transects, but not with point transects.

In this case, I want to apply a Hierarchical Distance Model in R for each surveyed species to estimate the abundance of each one considering the effect of different habitats and seasons in a semi-urban area. Points were randomly distributed in each habitat and each season. However, the observations were done only in half a circle of each point, because in most cases there were buildings.

I was wondering if there is a way to analyze this data using Distance, considering only a half-circle to model the detection probability. For the abundance estimation, I was thinking of including the surveyed area of each point as half the circle area. Also, it would be very helpful if you could recommend me some papers or examples for me to follow.

Thank you in advance for your help
Best regards,
Antonella

Dra. Antonella Gorosábel
Becaria doctoral CONICET
Grupo de Recursos Naturales y Gestión Ambiental, IPADS INTA-CONICET, Balcarce, Argentina
gorosabel...@inta.gob.ar
agoro...@gmail.com

messages.author: 75e0b0abcbafbc7d
messages.subject: Re: {Suspected Spam} [distance-sampling] Distance sampling using point transects in half a circle
parts:
Antonella

The Distance R package does not perform hierarchial distance sampling to model point-specific estimates of abundance.  However it can accommodate point transect sampling in which only a portion of the disks surrounding the stations are able to be sampled.  That is accomplished by specifying the Effort field associated with each point transect the proportion of the disk that is sampled.

messages.author: 7482eee8d2863d12
messages.subject: Re: {Suspected Spam} [distance-sampling] Distance sampling using point transects in half a circle
parts:
Antonella,

Further to Eric's message, there is a point transect density surface
modelling example (using the dsm package in R) at

https://examples.distancesampling.org/

(direct link to this particular example is

https://examples.distancesampling.org/dsm-point/hare_point_transect_dsm-distill.html

). That example uses only spatial coordinates (x, y) as spatial density
covariates, while it sounds like you have additional/alternative
potential covariates such as habitat and season - but this works just
the same was as for line transect analyses so hopefully your experience
there will be helpful.

With best wishes, Len
